preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 20,000.
Each test case must have between 2 and 200,000 vertices and between 1 and the minimum of 200,000 and n*(n-1)/2 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t_i <= 1 for t_i in range(m)) and all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n for x_i, y_i in zip(range(m), range(m)))
preconditions.description: All edges must have valid types and connect valid vertices within the range.

postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', it must indicate impossibility. If 'YES', it must be followed by m lines describing the directed edges.
There must be at least one undirected edge to attempt direction.

postconditions.expression: all((x_i, y_i) not in edges or (y_i, x_i) not in edges for x_i, y_i in zip(range(m), range(m)))
postconditions.description: No two edges can form a cycle in the resulting directed acyclic graph.
